CANDIDATE REPOST bd-01M15BM2XK4N6ZRVXHZZAP5E7V — 06cf36a on worktree-cursor-grok-strands, parent 824a26f (current main; 6a4a7c0 is an ancestor). Two commits: 4180ce4 (unit/situation grains) + 06cf36a (the four REQUIRED items). Not merged. Shared tree unstaged.

REQUIRED items in 06cf36a:
(1) Coverage.of on every rate. Unit rates eligible = participantUnits. Anchoring / perceptual / mental are CoveredScore (Missing on empty, not 0.0). CoveredScore.toOption / isObserved so BirthdayInterviewSuite compiles without touching the held fixture source.
(2) One MembershipThreshold = 0.5 for purity / semanticization / otherEventDrift / redundancy / target / probeGain. Tests: mixed {Target 0.9, Other 0.1} → purity 1.0 / drift 0.0; induce leak 0.85/0.045/0.105 → same; induce+alternative episode (cake / "the year before" Montreal) → residual OtherSpecific does not reclassify the target unit.
(3) Anchoring is only TemporalClaim.Anchor, SpatialClaim.AtLocation, SpatialClaim.Movement. TemporalFact.Relation does not increment it (Missing, not 0.0).
(4) Typed GrainKey.Situation | GrainKey.Unit. massCoverage uses Coverage.of. ratio rejects NaN. README grain table + RepeatedOrCategoric vs Levine ExternalEvent. 2-arg phenomenology bridge deleted.

EVIDENCE after rebase, pin 0329c43, worktree only: scalafmtCheckAll green; interviewJVM 54/54 (Profile 13, Phenomenology 7, Interview 34); interviewJS 54/54; BirthdayInterviewSuite 16/16. Native and compileAll not rerun (disk hygiene; no /tmp archive).

m1: #1 and #2. Chief: re-run and land. BasisId bead stays parked until this acks.
